programme.title: Der kleine Nick und die Ferien
Arthur und die Freunde der Tafelrunde
Creaturi sălbatice subacvatice
programme.desc: Aventurați-vă în sălbăticia intactă din Snares Islands, un sanctuar îndepărtat al animalelor protejat de marea neliniștită. Țopăiți împreună cu o colonie de pinguini cu creastă Snares, planați în zbor alături de uriașa pasăre a furtunii și furtunarul cenușiu și răcniți laolaltă cu uriașii lei de mare.

programme.title: Creaturi sălbatice subacvatice
programme.desc: Porniți în călătorie către Peninsula Otago din Noua Zeelandă, un refugiu pentru înmulțirea speciilor de păsări și mamifere marine în pericol de extincție. Urmăriți cum leii de mare, albatroșii, pescărușii cu cioc roșu și rândunicile de mare își găsesc perechea și apoi au grijă de următoarea generație.

programme.title: Creaturi sălbatice subacvatice
programme.desc: Descoperiți un tărâm al contrastelor în vârful Insulei de Sud a Noii Zeelande, unde unul dintre cele mai lungi bancuri de nisip din lume atrage sitari de mal nordici și balene-pilot flămânde, în timp ce văile cufundate ale râurilor asigură bufetul pentru delfinii întunecați și focile cu blană din Noua Zeelandă.

programme.title: Creaturi sălbatice subacvatice
programme.desc: Scufundă-te în apele pline de viață ale Golfului Hauraki, în apropiere de Auckland, Noua Zeelandă, și explorează adevăratul paradis al creaturilor oceanice. Urmărește un diavol de mare cum se furișează, distrează-te cu delfinii poznași și admiră peștii tropicali.

programme.title: Creaturi sălbatice subacvatice
programme.desc: Lasă-te învăluit de magia stranie a Insulelor Trei Regi, un arhipelag izolat din partea de nord a Noii Zeelande. Înoată alături de un grup de delfini cu bot gros, ia parte la o vânătoare de rândunici de mare cu coadă scurtă și simte suspansul când o bandă de orci prădătoare intră în scenă.

programme.title: Creaturi sălbatice subacvatice
programme.desc: Călătorește spre Insulele Cook, destinația preferată a 3.000 de balene cu cocoașă, care sunt pregătite să se împerecheze și să-și crească puii. Fii martorul unor scoici gigantice și a unor broaște țestoase verzi care prosperă în imensul recif de corali al insulelor și aruncă o privire spre trecutul nostru evolutiv.

programme.title: Urgențe în sălbăticie
programme.desc: Vară aglomerată la RSPCA Wildlife Hospital, unde veterinarul Emily ajută o koala să elimine gaze. Echipa luptă împotriva unei epidemii de paralizie lorikeet. Veterinarul Karina folosește un ursuleț de pluș pentru a salva un pui de pteropus.

programme.title: Urgențe în sălbăticie
programme.desc: Veterinarii Emily și Martine sterilizează o koala, dar operația se complică. O echidnă rătăcită primește ajutor de la veterinarul Nigel, agentul de salvare Chantelle ajută o șopârlă și veterinarul Karina investighează un posibil furt de păsări.

programme.title: Urgențe în sălbăticie
programme.desc: Koala Mara are nevoie de o operație de salvare a unui dinte, și o examinați o veveriță rănită cu veterinarul Tim. Agentul de salvare Elise scoate o vulpe zburătoare dintr-un canal și vedeți cum clocesc ouăle de piton ale asistentei Bree.

programme.title: Urgențe în sălbăticie
programme.desc: Agenții de salvare folosesc o tehnică specială pentru a prinde un koala cu ochii inflamați. Veterinarul Tim calmează un oposum cu picioarele arse, apoi Karina examinează un ornitorinc pe jumătate înecat înainte de a-l trimite la un specialist.

programme.title: Urgențe în sălbăticie
programme.desc: Veterinarul Claire îngrijește pui de koala, apoi salvați o veveriță prinsă în sârmă ghimpată. Aveți grijă de o bufniță epuizată și aveți o mare surpriză când veterinarul Tim face radiografii unei țestoase lovite de o mașină.

programme.title: 13 ore pentru supraviețuire
programme.desc: În bazinul cu maree, un crab pustnic vânează, un pui de rechin pisică are vecini ciudați, iar o caracatiță terorizează prada. Pescărușii și alte creaturi care vânează la suprafață, căldura se intensifică și oxigenul se epuizează în bazin.

programme.title: 13 ore pentru supraviețuire
programme.desc: Soarele apune și prădătorii dau târcoale piscinei înainte ca mareea să coboare. Perseverează la căderea nopții alături de un melc cleptoman și o scoică acrobată, în timp ce o pereche de crabi vicleni încearcă o poveste de dragoste periculoasă.

programme.title: Latura sălbatică a Lunii
programme.desc: Vezi cum fazele lunii stabilesc ritmul unei lupte nesfârșite între prădător și pradă. Plutește alături de colugo, savurează un festin cu fructe de mare alături de macaci și vezi o haită de lei care încearcă să transforme în cină un pui de elefant.

programme.title: Latura sălbatică a Lunii
programme.desc: Vizitează o lume a romantismului și a aventurii. Îndrăgostește-te de dansuri de împerechere, vezi o pereche de vulpi polare, plutește printre pești într-un recif de corali și vizitează bazinele luminate de lună ale broaștelor fierar.

programme.title: Supraviețuirea fiarei
programme.desc: Călătoriți prin deșertul Namibiei cu elefantul de tufiș și aflați cum se răcorește într-un loc cu puțină hrană sau umbră. Descoperiți cum acest gigant consumă anumite plante, sapă fântâni și parcurge dune nesfârșite în căutarea apei prețioase.

programme.title: Supraviețuirea fiarei
programme.desc: Într-o pădure de mangrove din Borneo, crocodilul de apă sărată este perfect adaptat la viața printre rădăcinile acvatice. Descoperiți cum își reglează temperatura folosindu-se de mediu și de ce răbdarea sa epică îl face un super vânător.

programme.title: Supraviețuirea fiarei
programme.desc: Descoperiți arta de a face cuiburi cu maestrul constructor al junglei: urangutanul. Max încearcă să scape de terenul plin de insecte al pădurii tropicale din Borneo - inspiră-te din isprăvile naturale de inginer ale acestei primate solitare.

programme.title: 13 ore pentru supraviețuire
programme.desc: În bazinul cu maree, un crab pustnic vânează, un pui de rechin pisică are vecini ciudați, iar o caracatiță terorizează prada. Pescărușii și alte creaturi care vânează la suprafață, căldura se intensifică și oxigenul se epuizează în bazin.

programme.title: 13 ore pentru supraviețuire
programme.desc: Soarele apune și prădătorii dau târcoale piscinei înainte ca mareea să coboare. Perseverează la căderea nopții alături de un melc cleptoman și o scoică acrobată, în timp ce o pereche de crabi vicleni încearcă o poveste de dragoste periculoasă.

programme.title: Latura sălbatică a Lunii
programme.desc: Vezi cum fazele lunii stabilesc ritmul unei lupte nesfârșite între prădător și pradă. Plutește alături de colugo, savurează un festin cu fructe de mare alături de macaci și vezi o haită de lei care încearcă să transforme în cină un pui de elefant.

programme.title: Supraviețuirea fiarei
programme.desc: Călătoriți prin deșertul Namibiei cu elefantul de tufiș și aflați cum se răcorește într-un loc cu puțină hrană sau umbră. Descoperiți cum acest gigant consumă anumite plante, sapă fântâni și parcurge dune nesfârșite în căutarea apei prețioase.

programme.title: Latura sălbatică a Lunii
programme.desc: Vizitează o lume a romantismului și a aventurii. Îndrăgostește-te de dansuri de împerechere, vezi o pereche de vulpi polare, plutește printre pești într-un recif de corali și vizitează bazinele luminate de lună ale broaștelor fierar.

programme.title: Supraviețuirea fiarei
programme.desc: Într-o pădure de mangrove din Borneo, crocodilul de apă sărată este perfect adaptat la viața printre rădăcinile acvatice. Descoperiți cum își reglează temperatura folosindu-se de mediu și de ce răbdarea sa epică îl face un super vânător.

programme.title: Supraviețuirea fiarei
programme.desc: Descoperiți arta de a face cuiburi cu maestrul constructor al junglei: urangutanul. Max încearcă să scape de terenul plin de insecte al pădurii tropicale din Borneo - inspiră-te din isprăvile naturale de inginer ale acestei primate solitare.

programme.title: Urgențe în sălbăticie
programme.desc: Veterinarul Claire îngrijește pui de koala, apoi salvați o veveriță prinsă în sârmă ghimpată. Aveți grijă de o bufniță epuizată și aveți o mare surpriză când veterinarul Tim face radiografii unei țestoase lovite de o mașină.

programme.title: Câini sălbatici: fugind cu haita
programme.desc: Simțiți agonia stolului de berze atunci când își pierde un pui și participați la încăierarea dintre puii stolului Manzi care luptă pentru un loc în ierarhie, dându-și seama care le sunt prietenii zgomotoși și care le sunt dușmanii. Acceptați misiunea lui Julz de căutare a stolului Kakuli dispărut în pustiul Badlands.

programme.title: Regatele ascunse ale Africii
programme.desc: O centură îngustă și neregulată de pe coasta vestică din sudul Africii e tărâmul contrastelor unde creaturile sunt nevoite să se adapteze ca să supraviețuiască. Facem cunoștință cu locuitori carismatici care se simt acasă în această zonă fragilă de trecere dintre ocean și uscat.

programme.title: Povestiri sălbatice de la fermă
programme.desc: Este primăvară, iar ferma s-a trezit la viață. Urmărește o oaie dând naștere la gemeni, un vițel orfan Hereford străduindu-se să-și găsească o mamă surogat și o găină cuibărindu-se în coteț.

programme.title: Povestiri sălbatice de la fermă
programme.desc: Gustă viața de la fermă pe timp de vară. Urmărește animalele sufocându-se din pricina unui val de căldură, răcorește-te în pârâul cu apă dulce din apropiere și pune-ți deoparte provizii pentru toamnă.

programme.title: Povestiri sălbatice de la fermă
programme.desc: Urmărește cum se adaptează viața de la fermă pe măsură ce frunzele încep să ruginească. Oile își întețesc blănurile de lână ca să le țină de cald când dă înghețul, iar albinele se hrănesc cu ultimul strop de nectar înainte să intre în hibernare.

programme.title: Povestiri sălbatice de la fermă
programme.desc: Iarna se apropie, iar animalele profită de ultimele bunătăți ale toamnei înainte să vină lunile reci și sterpe. Urmărește animalele care își caută refugiu și cele care sosesc din climatele nordice îndepărtate pentru a se stabili pe câmpurile arate.

programme.title: Din inima Texasului
programme.desc: Porniți într-o călătorie prin ochii somnilor, oceloților și altor creaturi native, alături de naratorul Matthew McConaughey. Bucurați-vă de peisajele și animalele din statul stelei singuratice și aflați cum eforturile de conservare pot salva habitatele unice din Texas.

programme.title: Regatul fluxului
programme.desc: Refluxul scoate la iveală o zonă de țărm numită zona tidală. E un loc al extremelor uluitoare, lovită de valurile puternice ale uraganelor și expusă arșiței crunte. Animalele de aici au evoluat în nenumărate moduri ciudate. Oamenii de știință explorează acest ținut ciudat.

programme.title: Misterele fluviului Mekong
programme.desc: Izvoarele fluviului Mekong se află la mare atitudine, pe platoul Tibetului, de unde curge spre provincia Yunnan, în China, unde începe călătoria noastră. Deși Yunnan ocupă mai puțin de 4% din teritoriul Chinei, aici sălășluiesc peste jumătate dintre păsările și mamiferele din această țară.

programme.title: Misterele fluviului Mekong
programme.desc: Munți abrupți și musoni tropicali definesc valea fluviului Mekong pe traseul său prin Laos. Surprinde imagini cu animalele sălbatice care își găsesc refugiul în ecosistemele sale vibrante, de la macaci la pescăruși și giboni cu creastă neagră.

programme.title: Misterele fluviului Mekong
programme.desc: Nordul temperat întâlnește sudul tropical de-a lungul malurilor Mekongului în Thailanda. Urmează fluviul prin Triunghiul de Aur și vezi dansurile de curtare ale numeroaselor specii de păsări. Apoi, mergi la un festival în onoarea spiritelor apei.

programme.title: Misterele fluviului Mekong
programme.desc: Explorează uimitoarele peșteri din provincia Khammouane din Laos. Aceste minuni naturale, înghesuite între fluviul Mekong și Munții Annamite, găzduiesc tot felul de animale, inclusiv lilieci, șopârle gecko, broaște și chilopode uriașe.

programme.title: Misterele fluviului Mekong
programme.desc: Pe măsură ce fluviul Mekong curge de-a lungul graniței de est a Thailandei, el sculptează pământul, creând cursuri de apă prin junglă. Fă o drumeție prin zone unde macacii rhesus, elefanții și vulpile zburătoare trăiesc în armonie la marginea apei.

programme.title: Orașul de coral
programme.desc: Descoperiți cel mai fantastic oraș de sub valuri, unde romantismul și navetiștii inundă autostrăzile recifului de corali. Urmăriți o broască țestoasă de mare verde în căutarea dragostei și stați de vorbă cu tatăl unui casuar care își îngrijește puii.

programme.title: Orașul de coral
programme.desc: Simțiți căldura verii; melci mari de mare încearcă să se ferească de o bandă de stele de mare înfometate. Rechinii de recif caută o masă la miezul nopții. Un pește papagal se deghizează pentru a supraviețui noaptea.

programme.title: Orașul de coral
programme.desc: Adaptare pe străzile de corali. Temperaturile mai ridicate decât cele normale îngreunează răcirea (și supraviețuirea) toamna. Iată o familie de pești clovn și proprietarul lor, o anemonă de mare. Peștii sanitari oferă diavolilor de mare o zi la spa.

programme.title: Orașul de coral
programme.desc: Simte răcoarea când iarna se apropie, domolind viața pe reciful agitat. Hoinărește printre rechini și caracatițe, vizitează o oază de corali pe o veche epavă și vezi o anghilă talentată atunci când se deghizează în prădător.

programme.title: Ținutul umbrelor
programme.desc: Colțul de sud-vest al Insulei de Sud a Noii Zeelande este mărginit de munți uriași și de Oceanul Pacific aspru. Pinguinii rari se joacă zilnic de-a șoarecele și pisica cu uriașii lei de mare din Noua Zeelandă. Leii de mare trăiesc, de asemenea, într-o lume tumultoasă, unde puii trebuie să se lupte cu elementele pentru a supraviețui.

programme.title: Ținutul umbrelor
programme.desc: În sud-vestul Noii Zeelande, fiordurile adânci și lagunele expuse mareei sunt învăluite în păduri tropicale verzi. Fiordurile întunecate adăpostesc creaturi care se găsesc în mod normal în adâncuri. Pe măsură ce se apropie iarna, delfinii nas de sticlă trebuie să scape din fiordul lor înghețat, în timp ce într-un râu de munte, un țipar cu aripioare lungi răspunde la chemarea mării.

programme.title: Ținutul umbrelor
programme.desc: Coasta de sud-est a Noii Zeelande este una dintre cele mai bogate zone de pescuit din lume - locul în care animalele marine tinere fac tranziția de la stadiul de novice la cel de adult independent. Balenele, delfinii și focile tinere învață să vâneze, învață regulile societății sau pornesc în propriile lor aventuri.

programme.title: Orașul de coral
programme.desc: Descoperiți cel mai fantastic oraș de sub valuri, unde romantismul și navetiștii inundă autostrăzile recifului de corali. Urmăriți o broască țestoasă de mare verde în căutarea dragostei și stați de vorbă cu tatăl unui casuar care își îngrijește puii.

Balenele, delfinii și focile tinere învață să vâneze, învață regulile societății sau pornesc în propriile lor aventuri.

programme.title: Câini sălbatici: fugind cu haita
programme.desc: Dodge, un leopard, se ospătează alături de câinii Manzi cu un ospăț furat. Stolul Kakuli nu are același noroc la vânătoare deoarece planurile lor au fost dejucate de o antilopă puku curajoasă. Găsiți stolul de berze, și adăpostiți-vă de elefanții încărcați împreună cu Jules și Simon.

programme.title: Povestea elefanților: Orfanii de la Reteti
programme.desc: Hai în Sanctuarul de Elefanți Reteti, unde mamele surogat dau lecții de supraviețuire și îngrijesc elefanții tineri. Cunoaște-l pe Long'uro fără trompă, și află de ce boala misterioasă a lui Kelele, de șase ani, i-ar putea întârzia eliberarea.

programme.title: Povestea elefanților: Orfanii de la Reteti
programme.desc: Urmărește durerea despărțirilor și speranța pentru viitor, când o generație de elefanți salvați este în sfârșit eliberată. Bun venit noilor membri ai familiei Reteti, un pui de elefant salvat dintr-o adăpătoare și o zebră traumatizată pe nume Kisima.

programme.title: Latura sălbatică a Lunii
programme.desc: Vezi cum fazele lunii stabilesc ritmul unei lupte nesfârșite între prădător și pradă. Plutește alături de colugo, savurează un festin cu fructe de mare alături de macaci și vezi o haită de lei care încearcă să transforme în cină un pui de elefant.

programme.title: Vânătorii Africii
programme.desc: Pentru ca micul clan Nsefu să supraviețuiască, tânărul Misfit și fratele său mai mare trebuie să devină buni vânători. Intrați pe teritoriul inamic, în timp ce leii se confruntă cu rivali dominanți și cu un clan puternic de hiene în căutarea prăzii.

programme.title: Vânătorii Africii
programme.desc: Faceți cunoștință cu micul pui de leopard răsfățat Chipadzua, care nu a trebuit niciodată să vâneze pentru hrană, datorită mamei sale răbdătoare. Singură pentru prima dată în viață, își va dezvolta ea abilitățile necesare supraviețuirii?

programme.title: Urgențe în sălbăticie
programme.desc: Tim face o cursă pentru a salva pe koala Ashley, apoi o vulpe zburătoare cu un deget în plus are nevoie de atenție din partea lui Martine. Calculați șansele pentru un pui de cangur rătăcit cu Emily, apoi sărbătoriți eliberarea a 50 de lorikete.

programme.title: Misterele fluviului Mekong
programme.desc: De la orezării îngrijite până la pădurile tropicale sălbatice, fluviul Mekong este sursa vieții în estul Thailandei. Urmărește gibonii cum negociază dinamica familială și vezi cum vipera aduce pericol pentru rețelele fragile de viață din regiune.

programme.title: Câini sălbatici: fugind cu haita
programme.desc: Filmați împreună cu Julz o vânătoare a câinilor sălbatici în timp ce acesta ajunge din urmă stolul Manzi care își consumă prada. Urmăriți leoparzii și hienele în timp ce stolul Kakuli își asumă riscuri enorme așteptând venirea ploilor. Mergeți la o vânătoare epică împreună cu un mascul reîntors în colonia de berze.

programme.title: Vânătorii Africii
programme.desc: Pentru ca micul clan Nsefu să supraviețuiască, tânărul Misfit și fratele său mai mare trebuie să devină buni vânători. Intrați pe teritoriul inamic, în timp ce leii se confruntă cu rivali dominanți și cu un clan puternic de hiene în căutarea prăzii.

programme.title: Vânătorii Africii
programme.desc: Faceți cunoștință cu micul pui de leopard răsfățat Chipadzua, care nu a trebuit niciodată să vâneze pentru hrană, datorită mamei sale răbdătoare. Singură pentru prima dată în viață, își va dezvolta ea abilitățile necesare supraviețuirii?

programme.title: Latura sălbatică a Lunii
programme.desc: Vizitează o lume a romantismului și a aventurii. Îndrăgostește-te de dansuri de împerechere, vezi o pereche de vulpi polare, plutește printre pești într-un recif de corali și vizitează bazinele luminate de lună ale broaștelor fierar.

programme.title: Apele Arabiei
programme.desc: E vară în golful Oman. Soarele necruțători din Arabia încălzește apele puțin adânci până la temperatura de 30 de grade Celsius, stimulând creșterea algelor de-a lungul marelui recif de corali. Acestea atrag mii de viețuitoare erbivore flămânde, astfel încât peștii se războiesc între ei pentru teritorii.

programme.title: Apele Arabiei
programme.desc: Țestoasa marină este unul dintre cele mai vechi animale de pe Terra. Acești marinari străvechi îi preced chiar pe dinozauri. Există relativ neschimbate de peste 100.000.000 de ani. Acum însă toate cele șapte specii sunt în pericol.

programme.title: Păsări sălbatice din Australia
programme.desc: Urmăriți povestea lui Hally și a lui Sally, o pereche de mici pinguini. Aceste păsări care nu pot zbura, înzestrate cu înotătoare, formează unele dintre cele mai zgomotoase adunări de animale din natură. Aici se desfășoară o saga familială a relațiilor fidele, a gospodăritului dedicat și a unei vieți nocturne însuflețite.

programme.title: Misterele fluviului Mekong
programme.desc: Străbătută de apele Mekongului, Cambodgia este definită prin relația sa cu acest fluviu. Află de ce țara este un punct fierbinte pentru biodiversitate și explorează refugiile secrete ale animalelor care supraviețuiesc în habitatele sale naturale.

programme.title: Vânătorii Africii

programme.title: Orașul de coral

Jurnal de viaţă
programme.desc: O emisiune despre excelența în profesia de medic, cu invitați profesioniști în domeniul medical, oameni care performează în acest domeniu. Formatul show-ului este acela de infodoc având linia narativă a unei biografii. Scopul emisiunii este acela de a-i apropia pe campionii domeniului de publicul telespectator, de a prezenta momentele de inflexiune din cariera acestora, performanţele profesionale, planurile de viitor, predincţiile acestora în ceea ce priveşte noile descoperiri şi tendinţe în domeniul lor de expertiză şi activitate.

programme.title: Medika special 1
programme.desc: Cu: Dana Chera.

programme.title: Medika special
programme.desc: Cu: Catalina Jingoiu.

programme.title: Telemedika
programme.desc: O emisiune care va avea ca invitați medici cunoscuți care ne vor învăța cum să ne ferim de anumite boli, unde vor fi expuse particularitățile acestor boli, dar și discuții despre tipuri de patologii. Emisiunea TeleMedika are un scop educativ pentru a încerca să învețe telespectatorul să prevină apariția diverselor afecțiuni. Formatul permite interacţiunea directă între medicii invitaţi şi telespectatori prin intermediul telefonului şi a reţelelor sociale.

programme.title: Academia de sănătate
programme.desc: Academia de Sănătate este un show informativ bazat, în mare parte, pe interviuri cu renumiți profesori universitari din domeniul medical. Subiectele emisiunii sunt de actualitate şi sunt menite să ridice misterul asupra unor boli cu notorietate și să facă lumină în ceea ce privește actul medical de calitate. Domeniul medical este unul vast din toate punctele de vedere şi de aceea considerăm că introducerea în grila de programe a emisiunilor de acest tip este una benefică pentru telespectatori. În această emisiune telespectatorii au posibilitatea să fie informaţi direct de la cei ce sunt responsabili de actul medical. Formatl show-ului va încuraja dezbaterile, iar finalul va fi uşor de comunicat.

programme.desc: Private Tour takes you to discover the exhibition "Fernand Khnopff - The master of the enigma" at the Petit Palais in Paris. programme.title: Artist's Workshop
programme.desc: In this episode, we meet the artist Alain Godon. From the shores of France to the English countryside, from parachutist to nightclub manager, Alain Godon has had a thousand and one lives. But he has always remained a painter. He is a figurative painter with a naive and cheerful pencil stroke, who, far from fashions, trends and museum fads, is acclaimed by many collectors for whom he works from his workshop in Waltham in Kent.

programme.title: Origami
programme.desc: Origami is about the art of paper folding, a Japanese and Chinese millenary tradition. In modern usage, the word “origami” is used as an inclusive term for all paper folding, regardless of their cultural origin. Different folding and sculpting techniques, new models, bright colors – you’ll see all of this in our program! We will teach you how to transform a flat square sheet of paper into a finished sculpture – from simple to complex!

programme.title: Raw Art: When one looks, one finds it!
programme.desc: This documentary travels to France to question the contours of Raw Art. Savine Faupin, curator of the department Art Brut at LAM, Matthew Morin, connoisseur and collector Christian Berst, owner of the eponymous gallery: each character tries to put his own definition of an art difficult to grasp. Indeed, Raw Art is constantly renewing itself, it is not limited by time or by the style and remains foremost vector emotional message.

programme.desc: A native of the southern French town of Grasse, Jean-Honoré Fragonard is one of the most important 18th century French painters. He studied at the French Academy in Rome but chose to be free in his work, preferring to carry out private commissions, some of which were licentious, such as “The Shirt Withdrawn” exposed at the Louvre. The “Fanciful Figure” exposed at the Louvre-Lens demonstrates an original and very modern style. One of his masterpieces is without doubt the painting “The Bolt”, in the collection of the Louvre in Paris.\r\nEnjoy your visit!

programme.desc: From “simple” tags to gigantic, colorful murals and collages, street art that was once suppressed is now officially open to the eye of the beholder. When did this shift take place? How do artists themselves experience this change in status and perception? Has their approach evolved along with their art?\r\nTo tell these stories, we've come up with a fabulous playground: Laon's International Urban Arts festival.

programme.desc: In this episode, we meet Cheryl Dunn, photographer. After moving to New York City in the mid-1980s, she spent much of her career photographing the city's streets and the people who made their mark on them. In the late 1990s, she began to focus on film, creating classic films about artists of her generation who influenced the realities of urban life through their own work.

The works are displayed in such a way that visitors can observe the evolution of drawings over five centuries. There are drawings by the Italian artist Frederico Zuccari (or Zuccaro) but also the Dutch artist Peter Paul Rubens.

programme.title: Museum stories
programme.desc: In the heart of the Montparnasse district, the Bourdelle Museum remains one of the last testimonies of these groups of artists which flourished in Paris at the threshold of the 20th century. The Antoine Bourdelle Museum offers an opportunity to see the work being created it, as close as possible to the material, in the museum's workshop spirit. Plaster, earth, sandstone and bronzes, but also sketches, variations and variations, reveal the process of development and the working method of an artist as fertile as inventive.

programme.title: Within the frame
programme.desc: A key artist of the Italian Renaissance, Raffaello Santi (1483-1520) developed a classical art form, based on drawing, which made him the model for many painters in the following centuries. His favourite theme was the Madonna: you can admire, for example, “The Sistine Madonna” in Dresden and the “The Virgin and Child with St John the Baptist” in the Louvre. Notice the gentle harmony and the delicate sensuality in “The Three Graces” or the powerful human presence in “The Portrait of Baldassare Castiglione”.\r\nEnjoy your visit!

programme.title: When I grow up I'll be a photographer
programme.desc: In this episode, Christina, a student, is going to play the game and take pictures for a jewelry brand. We will attend a first year image analysis class. The students who did a photoshoot with a duck in the previous episode will edit the photos, and one student will organize a photoshoot on the street.

programme.title: Photo Contest
programme.desc: Two photographers compete on a given theme. Agnès Grégoire, editor-in-chief of PHOTO magazine, will then have to decide between them and choose the best of the two. Today, the Phocaean city is at the heart of the competition: the two competitors must capture the most aesthetic and unusual aspects of it.

programme.title: Artist's Workshop
programme.desc: In this episode, we will talk about the artist Antoine Bourdelle. Son of a carpenter who moved to the capital, Antoine Bourdelle became the most important official sculptor at the beginning of the 20th century. This pupil of Rodin took on numerous commissions in France and abroad. But he also kept some of his sculptures still present today in his workshop in the Montparnasse district, a magical place, which has remained frozen in the past.

programme.title: Within the frame
programme.desc: In the second half of the 19th century, Edouard Manet (1832-1883) showed great originality in his painting of historic scenes and portraiture of well-known figures, such as the novelist Zola and the poet Mallarmé. Even if we cannot call him the first Impressionist, his leading role in the history of modern art must be emphasised. The scandals in 1863 caused by “The Luncheon on the Grass” or “Olympia” both exposed at the Orsay Museum effectively mark the beginning of modern painting.\r\nEnjoy your visit!

programme.title: John Singer Sargent - Portraitist of Paradox
programme.desc:
From September 22, 2025 to January 11, 2026, following its presentation at The Metropolitan Museum of Art in New York, the Musée d’Orsay will devote a major exhibition to John Singer Sargent (1856–1925), marking the centenary of the painter’s death.
A century after his passing, John Singer Sargent—celebrated for his portraits of French, English, and American high society during the Belle Époque—remains an enigma. Beneath a façade of carefully maintained respectability, his work nonetheless shocked his contemporaries with its sensuality and candor. Idolized by a wealthy elite eager to pay a fortune to sit for him, another side of his oeuvre reveals his fascination with Bedouins, Spanish dancers, and Venetian gondoliers.
This film offers a portrait full of contradictions: an American born in Florence, we follow him from his nomadic childhood across Europe, through the salons of Paris and London, and finally to the United States, his homeland.
Although immensely successful during his life.

programme.title: The decisive moment
programme.desc: In this episode, we will meet Martin Schoeller, German photographer. His style is characterized by a similar treatment of all subjects photographed, whether they are famous or anonymous. His portraits of Brad Pitt, Steve Carrel, Bradley Cooper and many others, are published in renowned magazines.

programme.title: Artist's Workshop
programme.desc: In this episode, we will meet the artist Ben. Active on the contemporary art scene for over 50 years, he is a self-taught, multi-faceted character. His success is undeniable. If his status as an artist is affirmed through his famous writings painted in white cursive letters on a black background, his temperament as a "jack of all trades" has made him one of the most avant-garde artistic personalities in the art world since the 1960s. Attached more than anything else to his region, the artist has been working and living for over 40 years in the heights of Nice, in Saint-Pancrace, in a house where each room can become a studio, and where the progressive lack of space has led him to create an extension, the doors of which he is now opening to us.

programme.title: Warning ! Fresh paint
programme.desc: Move along, there's nothing to see! In April 2018, the Museum "La Piscine de Roubaix" prepared to expand its exhibition space. In a period of six months, several thousand works had to be unhooked, dusted, restored, moved, and reinstalled. These are unique works for which any handling required extreme precautions. Bruno Gaudichon, curator and founder of the museum, had to employ and bring together several workers in ordert to complete a successful reopening.

programme.desc: In this episode we visit the city of Vallauris where Pablo Picasso became fascinated by the town and the ceramics after visiting an exhibition and it’s where he lived for a decade. The city remains forever marked by the work of this protean artist. Picasso is known in Vallauris for the chapel of the castle and its impressive cycle of paintings entitled "War and Peace". It is also in the museum of ceramics that some of the most beautiful works of the "potter" Picasso are exhibited. The sculpture of “Man with a Sheep”, placed on the Market Square, testifies to the artist's attachment to the city and its inhabitants. In 1959, the castle chapel was inaugurated with his masterpiece "War and Peace" just across the museum Magnelli.

programme.desc: Claude Monet is probably the best-known painter of the impressionist movement. Indeed, the term “impressionism” was derived from his painting “Impression Rising Sun” (1872). This exhibition retraces the great stages in Monet’s prolific career while dwelling on paintings of this master that cannot be ignored: the “Saint Lazare Station”, the “Poppies near Argenteuil”, the “Haystacks” and the “Rouen Cathedral” exposed all around the world in different museum such as the Museum of Fine Arts in Boston without forgetting his “Water-lilies” exposed at the Orangerie museum in Paris. \r\nEnjoy your visit!

programme.title: Within the frame
programme.desc: Although Degas’ art is difficult to classify, it is often associated with the impressionist movement, which emerged in France at the end of the 19th century. Nevertheless, he developed a very personal style with a preference for indoors subjects rather than the open-air scenes favoured by the impressionist painters. The 10 masterpieces presented here are a good illustration of Degas’ preferred themes: the show, the bath, family portraits and the working classes.\r\nDiscover " The Ballet classe " exposed at the Orsay Museum or the " Blue Dancers " at the Fine arts Museum Pouchkine.\r\nEnjoy your visit!

programme.title: Othoniel Cosmos - An Artist in Avignon
programme.desc: Cosmos, an Artist in Avignon is a poetic documentary that follows Jean-Michel Othoniel during the creation of his monumental exhibition in Avignon (2025–2026). Through his perspective, the film explores the intimate genesis of his works, from conception to realization, from spirit to matter.\r\nStructured around the four elements, this sensory journey takes us from Jean-Michel’s studio in Montreuil to the workshops of the many artisans collaborating on the project, as well as to the iconic sites of Avignon. The city becomes a stage where the artworks integrate and dialogue with the spaces, between contemporary installation and historical heritage.\r\nThe journey culminates in a choreographic performance by Carolyn Carlson, created for Othoniel’s works and performed by Hugo Marchand and Caroline Osmont, presented for the first time in the courtyard of the Palais des Papes.

programme.title: Artist's Workshop
programme.desc: It is in the center of Buenos Aires that Eduardo Stupia decided to install his studio entirely dedicated to creation. In a 20th century house, wedged between two modern buildings, he occupies a large space in which he can indulge in his favorite art, drawing. His works, which he describes himself as abstract landscapes, are drawn with pencil, charcoal or Indian ink. In his heterogeneous compositions, where the graphic language and the precision of the gesture hold a central place, Eduardo Stupia explores the semantics of the drawing and opens the fields of the imagination.

programme.title: Within the frame
programme.desc: Born in 1866 in Moscow, Wassily Kandinsky is considered as one of the most important 20th century artists. He was notably the founder of abstract art. Having left Russia for Germany where he started teaching at the Bauhaus in 1922, he then settled in France in 1933 and left behind him a particularly abundant work. You will rediscover here his most emblematic creations, essentially drawn from the collection of the Centre Pompidou in Paris.\r\nEnjoy your visit!

programme.title: Museum stories
programme.desc: The city of Boulogne Billancourt experienced rapid development in the interwar period. Industrialists, filmmakers, architects, painters and sculptors test their creativity there. It is this impetus that the Museum of the 1930s would have liked to transcribe, created a collection of works of art from this period, first constituted by purchases in galleries, flea markets or auction houses, then mainly by donations. More than 1,500 sculptures, 800 paintings, 300 pieces of furniture… A heterogeneous whole, testimony of an era and a place in which the artistic excitement unfolds, and opens the way to a number of creative adventures of the 20th century.

programme.title: Photo Contest
programme.desc: Today, we go to Marseille where two new candidates will compete. Juan Bosco Gomez Herrera and Lilian Heymans will have one hour to take the best possible photograph on the imposed theme of the sea.

Look closely at the famous “Arnolfini Portrait” exposed at the National Gallery, where the circular mirror at the back of the room shows the artist’s reflection, or the beautiful “Virgin of Chancellor Rolin” exposed at the Louvre, a picture in which three arches open onto a river landscape.\r\nEnjoy your visit!

The “Water-Lily Pond” portrays this garden, with its water lilies and the Japanese bridge in the background. In the series of eight large canvases on the theme, housed in the Musée de l’Orangerie in Paris, Monet introduces variations in light according to the hour of the day.\r\nEnjoy your visit!

programme.desc: Born 31 years ago in Roubaix, Quentin Carnaille quickly became a force on the art scene north of France. Former architecture student, Carnaille has always been fascinated by how things work. His early works were influenced by clockwork mechanisms, he has diverted from their main use to create jewelry and accessories. It then focuses on the realization of sculptures and greater works with the same aesthetic and inspiration. The contemporary and futuristic ideas influence his work from the beginning, based on its initial orientation on the past and the origins of humanity.

The “Fanciful Figure” exposed at the Louvre-Lens demonstrates an original and very modern style. One of his masterpieces is without doubt the painting “The Bolt”, in the collection of the Louvre in Paris.\r\nEnjoy your visit!

Has their approach evolved along with their art?\r\nTo tell these stories, we've come up with a fabulous playground: Laon's International Urban Arts festival.

In the late 1990s, she began to focus on film, creating classic films about artists of her generation who influenced the realities of urban life through their own work.

The Antoine Bourdelle Museum offers an opportunity to see the work being created it, as close as possible to the material, in the museum's workshop spirit. Plaster, earth, sandstone and bronzes, but also sketches, variations and variations, reveal the process of development and the working method of an artist as fertile as inventive.

programme.title: Within the frame
programme.desc: A key artist of the Italian Renaissance, Raffaello Santi (1483-1520) developed a classical art form, based on drawing, which made him the model for many painters in the following centuries. His favourite theme was the Madonna: you can admire, for example, “The Sistine Madonna” in Dresden and the “The Virgin and Child with St John the Baptist” in the Louvre. Notice the gentle harmony and the delicate sensuality in “The Three Graces” or the powerful human presence in “The Portrait of Baldassare Castiglione”.\r\nEnjoy your visit!

programme.title: Photo Contest

Today, the Phocaean city is at the heart of the competition: the two competitors must capture the most aesthetic and unusual aspects of it.

programme.title: Artist's Workshop
programme.desc: In this episode, we will talk about the artist Antoine Bourdelle. Son of a carpenter who moved to the capital, Antoine Bourdelle became the most important official sculptor at the beginning of the 20th century. This pupil of Rodin took on numerous commissions in France and abroad. But he also kept some of his sculptures still present today in his workshop in the Montparnasse district, a magical place, which has remained frozen in the past.

programme.title: Within the frame
programme.desc: In the second half of the 19th century, Edouard Manet (1832-1883) showed great originality in his painting of historic scenes and portraiture of well-known figures, such as the novelist Zola and the poet Mallarmé. Even if we cannot call him the first Impressionist, his leading role in the history of modern art must be emphasised. The scandals in 1863 caused by “The Luncheon on the Grass” or “Olympia” both exposed at the Orsay Museum effectively mark the beginning of modern painting.\r\nEnjoy your visit!

programme.title: John Singer Sargent - Portraitist of Paradox
programme.desc:
From September 22, 2025 to January 11, 2026, following its presentation at The Metropolitan Museum of Art in New York, the Musée d’Orsay will devote a major exhibition to John Singer Sargent (1856–1925), marking the centenary of the painter’s death.
A century after his passing, John Singer Sargent—celebrated for his portraits of French, English, and American high society during the Belle Époque—remains an enigma. Beneath a façade of carefully maintained respectability, his work nonetheless shocked his contemporaries with its sensuality and candor. Idolized by a wealthy elite eager to pay a fortune to sit for him, another side of his oeuvre reveals his fascination with Bedouins, Spanish dancers, and Venetian gondoliers.
This film offers a portrait full of contradictions: an American born in Florence, we follow him from his nomadic childhood across Europe, through the salons of Paris and London, and finally to the United States, his homeland.
Although immensely successful during his life.

programme.title: The decisive moment
programme.desc: In this episode, we will meet Martin Schoeller, German photographer. His style is characterized by a similar treatment of all subjects photographed, whether they are famous or anonymous. His portraits of Brad Pitt, Steve Carrel, Bradley Cooper and many others, are published in renowned magazines.

programme.title: Artist's Workshop
programme.desc: In this episode, we will meet the artist Ben. Active on the contemporary art scene for over 50 years, he is a self-taught, multi-faceted character. His success is undeniable. If his status as an artist is affirmed through his famous writings painted in white cursive letters on a black background, his temperament as a "jack of all trades" has made him one of the most avant-garde artistic personalities in the art world since the 1960s. Attached more than anything else to his region, the artist has been working and living for over 40 years in the heights of Nice, in Saint-Pancrace, in a house where each room can become a studio, and where the progressive lack of space has led him to create an extension, the doors of which he is now opening to us.

The sculpture of “Man with a Sheep”, placed on the Market Square, testifies to the artist's attachment to the city and its inhabitants. programme.title: Within the frame

programme.title: Othoniel Cosmos - An Artist in Avignon
programme.desc: Cosmos, an Artist in Avignon is a poetic documentary that follows Jean-Michel Othoniel during the creation of his monumental exhibition in Avignon (2025–2026). Through his perspective, the film explores the intimate genesis of his works, from conception to realization, from spirit to matter.\r\nStructured around the four elements, this sensory journey takes us from Jean-Michel’s studio in Montreuil to the workshops of the many artisans collaborating on the project, as well as to the iconic sites of Avignon. The city becomes a stage where the artworks integrate and dialogue with the spaces, between contemporary installation and historical heritage.\r\nThe journey culminates in a choreographic performance by Carolyn Carlson, created for Othoniel’s works and performed by Hugo Marchand and Caroline Osmont, presented for the first time in the courtyard of the Palais des Papes.

programme.title: Artist's Workshop
programme.desc: It is in the center of Buenos Aires that Eduardo Stupia decided to install his studio entirely dedicated to creation. In a 20th century house, wedged between two modern buildings, he occupies a large space in which he can indulge in his favorite art, drawing. His works, which he describes himself as abstract landscapes, are drawn with pencil, charcoal or Indian ink. In his heterogeneous compositions, where the graphic language and the precision of the gesture hold a central place, Eduardo Stupia explores the semantics of the drawing and opens the fields of the imagination.

programme.title: Within the frame
programme.desc: Born in 1866 in Moscow, Wassily Kandinsky is considered as one of the most important 20th century artists. He was notably the founder of abstract art. Having left Russia for Germany where he started teaching at the Bauhaus in 1922, he then settled in France in 1933 and left behind him a particularly abundant work. You will rediscover here his most emblematic creations, essentially drawn from the collection of the Centre Pompidou in Paris.\r\nEnjoy your visit!

programme.title: Museum stories
programme.desc: The city of Boulogne Billancourt experienced rapid development in the interwar period. Industrialists, filmmakers, architects, painters and sculptors test their creativity there. It is this impetus that the Museum of the 1930s would have liked to transcribe, created a collection of works of art from this period, first constituted by purchases in galleries, flea markets or auction houses, then mainly by donations. More than 1,500 sculptures, 800 paintings, 300 pieces of furniture… A heterogeneous whole, testimony of an era and a place in which the artistic excitement unfolds, and opens the way to a number of creative adventures of the 20th century.

Has their approach evolved along with their art?\r\nTo tell these stories, we've come up with a fabulous playground: Laon's International Urban Arts festival.

In the late 1990s, she began to focus on film, creating classic films about artists of her generation who influenced the realities of urban life through their own work.

There are drawings by the Italian artist Frederico Zuccari (or Zuccaro) but also the Dutch artist Peter Paul Rubens.

Plaster, earth, sandstone and bronzes, but also sketches, variations and variations, reveal the process of development and the working method of an artist as fertile as inventive.

programme.desc: A key artist of the Italian Renaissance, Raffaello Santi (1483-1520) developed a classical art form, based on drawing, which made him the model for many painters in the following centuries. His favourite theme was the Madonna: you can admire, for example, “The Sistine Madonna” in Dresden and the “The Virgin and Child with St John the Baptist” in the Louvre. Notice the gentle harmony and the delicate sensuality in “The Three Graces” or the powerful human presence in “The Portrait of Baldassare Castiglione”.\r\nEnjoy your visit!

Today, the Phocaean city is at the heart of the competition: the two competitors must capture the most aesthetic and unusual aspects of it.

programme.desc: In this episode, we will talk about the artist Antoine Bourdelle. Son of a carpenter who moved to the capital, Antoine Bourdelle became the most important official sculptor at the beginning of the 20th century. This pupil of Rodin took on numerous commissions in France and abroad. But he also kept some of his sculptures still present today in his workshop in the Montparnasse district, a magical place, which has remained frozen in the past.

programme.title: Within the frame
programme.desc: In the second half of the 19th century, Edouard Manet (1832-1883) showed great originality in his painting of historic scenes and portraiture of well-known figures, such as the novelist Zola and the poet Mallarmé. Even if we cannot call him the first Impressionist, his leading role in the history of modern art must be emphasised. The scandals in 1863 caused by “The Luncheon on the Grass” or “Olympia” both exposed at the Orsay Museum effectively mark the beginning of modern painting.\r\nEnjoy your visit!

programme.title: John Singer Sargent - Portraitist of Paradox
programme.desc:
From September 22, 2025 to January 11, 2026, following its presentation at The Metropolitan Museum of Art in New York, the Musée d’Orsay will devote a major exhibition to John Singer Sargent (1856–1925), marking the centenary of the painter’s death.
A century after his passing, John Singer Sargent—celebrated for his portraits of French, English, and American high society during the Belle Époque—remains an enigma. Beneath a façade of carefully maintained respectability, his work nonetheless shocked his contemporaries with its sensuality and candor. Idolized by a wealthy elite eager to pay a fortune to sit for him, another side of his oeuvre reveals his fascination with Bedouins, Spanish dancers, and Venetian gondoliers.
This film offers a portrait full of contradictions: an American born in Florence, we follow him from his nomadic childhood across Europe, through the salons of Paris and London, and finally to the United States, his homeland.
Although immensely successful during his life.

His style is characterized by a similar treatment of all subjects photographed, whether they are famous or anonymous. His portraits of Brad Pitt, Steve Carrel, Bradley Cooper and many others, are published in renowned magazines.

programme.title: Artist's Workshop
programme.desc: In this episode, we will meet the artist Ben. Active on the contemporary art scene for over 50 years, he is a self-taught, multi-faceted character. His success is undeniable. If his status as an artist is affirmed through his famous writings painted in white cursive letters on a black background, his temperament as a "jack of all trades" has made him one of the most avant-garde artistic personalities in the art world since the 1960s. Attached more than anything else to his region, the artist has been working and living for over 40 years in the heights of Nice, in Saint-Pancrace, in a house where each room can become a studio, and where the progressive lack of space has led him to create an extension, the doors of which he is now opening to us.

It is also in the museum of ceramics that some of the most beautiful works of the "potter" Picasso are exhibited. The sculpture of “Man with a Sheep”, placed on the Market Square, testifies to the artist's attachment to the city and its inhabitants. The 10 masterpieces presented here are a good illustration of Degas’ preferred themes: the show, the bath, family portraits and the working classes.\r\nDiscover " The Ballet classe " exposed at the Orsay Museum or the " Blue Dancers " at the Fine arts Museum Pouchkine.\r\nEnjoy your visit!

programme.title: Othoniel Cosmos - An Artist in Avignon
programme.desc: Cosmos, an Artist in Avignon is a poetic documentary that follows Jean-Michel Othoniel during the creation of his monumental exhibition in Avignon (2025–2026). Through his perspective, the film explores the intimate genesis of his works, from conception to realization, from spirit to matter.\r\nStructured around the four elements, this sensory journey takes us from Jean-Michel’s studio in Montreuil to the workshops of the many artisans collaborating on the project, as well as to the iconic sites of Avignon. The city becomes a stage where the artworks integrate and dialogue with the spaces, between contemporary installation and historical heritage.\r\nThe journey culminates in a choreographic performance by Carolyn Carlson, created for Othoniel’s works and performed by Hugo Marchand and Caroline Osmont, presented for the first time in the courtyard of the Palais des Papes.

programme.title: Artist's Workshop
programme.desc: It is in the center of Buenos Aires that Eduardo Stupia decided to install his studio entirely dedicated to creation. In a 20th century house, wedged between two modern buildings, he occupies a large space in which he can indulge in his favorite art, drawing. His works, which he describes himself as abstract landscapes, are drawn with pencil, charcoal or Indian ink. In his heterogeneous compositions, where the graphic language and the precision of the gesture hold a central place, Eduardo Stupia explores the semantics of the drawing and opens the fields of the imagination.

programme.title: Within the frame
programme.desc: Born in 1866 in Moscow, Wassily Kandinsky is considered as one of the most important 20th century artists. He was notably the founder of abstract art. Having left Russia for Germany where he started teaching at the Bauhaus in 1922, he then settled in France in 1933 and left behind him a particularly abundant work. You will rediscover here his most emblematic creations, essentially drawn from the collection of the Centre Pompidou in Paris.\r\nEnjoy your visit!

programme.title: Exhibition on Screen
programme.desc:
Without Camille Pissarro, there is no Impressionist movement. He is rightfully known as the father of Impressionism.

It was a dramatic path that Pissarro followed, and throughout it all he wrote extensively to his family. It is through these intimate and revealing letters that this gripping film reveals Pissarro’s life and work.

Born in the West Indies, Pissarro found his passion in paint as a young man in Paris, and by the age of 43 had corralled a group of enthusiastic artists into a new collective. Their first show was scorned by the critics, but the group had acquired a new name: the Impressionists. For the next 40 years Pissarro was the driving force behind what has today become the world’s favourite artistic movement.

The Ashmolean Museum has a long tradition of excellence. As the UK’s first ever public museum (it opened its doors in May 1683) it houses a wonderfully rich collection, including the remarkable Pissarro archive. With exclusive access to most extensive archive of.

programme.title: Within the frame
programme.desc: With his considerable production of more than 6,000 works, Auguste Renoir took part in the emergence of the impressionist movement even if he were to distance himself from it later to assert a more personal style. This visit begins with his most famous masterpiece, the “Ball at the Moulin de la Galette”. You will also rediscover the “Dance in the City” and the “Piano Lesson” exposed at the Joslyn art museum as well as “Claude Renoir in Clown Costume”, a portrait of his son who was later to become one of France’s greatest film directors exposed at the Orangerie Museum in France \r\nEnjoy your visit!

programme.title: Art Quiz
programme.desc: Test and develop your artistic culture with Art Quiz, the game that will allow you to become unaware of art. Whether it's artists, works of art, artistic trends, the price of works... nothing will be a secret for you anymore. Now it's your turn to play!

programme.title: Architectures
programme.desc: The pyramid of Djoser, the oldest Egyptian pyramid - 2,600 BC - undoubtedly reveals the very first steps of what we call architecture, as a learned practice, distinct from simple construction. The place where this break takes place is a funerary monument, where symbolic function takes precedence over simple use. From the outset, architecture asserted itself not as a function but as a sign. Thirty kilometers south of Cairo, east of the Nile valley, Saqqarah was the necropolis of Memphis, the first capital of ancient Egypt, of which nothing remains except this immense cemetery dominated by the sixty-meter-high Step Pyramid of Djoser.

programme.title: Architectures
programme.desc: In 1598, King Abbas decided to make Isfahan his capital and planned a huge urban project.\r\nThe Royal Mosque is at once a place of prayer, a garden in the middle of the desert and a way of writing down the texts of the faith. It is also a school and a place of public hygiene. It embodies the unprecedented richness of an art of living, the power of a king and the talent of hundreds of craftsmen and artists.

programme.title: Stolen Treasures
programme.desc: On the evening of 13 July 1999, a day of celebrations in France, Rembrandt’s *The Boy with a Soap Bubble* disappeared from the Draguignan Municipal Museum. Patrick Vialaneix recounts how he fell in love with this painting at the age of 13. Thirteen years later, the painting continued to haunt him, and he decided to steal it so that he could always have it close to him and talk to it. He therefore hid in a cupboard in the museum, waiting for nightfall to make off with it. He turned himself in to the police in 2014.

programme.title: Stolen Treasures
programme.desc: Vandalised, stolen, cut into pieces, melted down and resold for a few thousand euros, even though they are worth millions: sculptures. On the night of 30–31 March 1999, whilst this park in the 6th arrondissement was closed to the public, individuals stole the sculpture of Picasso’s former muse and lover, Dora Maar: ‘Head of a Woman’, an 80-centimetre-tall bronze weighing 80 kilos. Two years later, in a town hall in the Paris suburbs, it stood proudly on the staircase: ‘Do you realise you’ve got a Picasso in your building?’ exclaimed an antique dealer who had come to visit the château. Indeed, the town hall had found a ‘large stone’ buried on a plot of land, had it cleaned, thought it was beautiful and displayed it in their château, unaware that it was a sculpture by Picasso….

programme.title: Stolen Treasures
programme.desc: Sisley was a British Impressionist painter, closely associated with Renoir and Monet. On 20 June 1978, at 8.30 pm, a truck was stolen. Inside were around ten masterpieces worth 1.5 billion francs. The transport company responsible for returning the works following a loan had made no security arrangements. On 21 September 1998, ‘The Avenue of Poplars’ was stolen once again. This time, it was the curator of the Musée des Beaux-Arts in Nice, Jean Fornéris, who staged his own abduction! Finally, on Sunday 5 August 2007, five masked and armed men held up staff at the Nice museum to steal four paintings, including the Sisley. It was not until 2008, with the help of the FBI – which was also searching for works stolen from the Boston Museum – that the thieves were arrested.

programme.title: Stolen Treasures
programme.desc: Painted by the Van Eyck brothers, ‘The Adoration of the Mystical Lamb’ or ‘The Ghent Altarpiece’ is regarded as one of the greatest masterpieces of the Flemish Primitives. Installed in St Bavon’s Cathedral in Ghent as early as 1432, it escaped theft and looting on several occasions, However, on the night of 10–11 April 1934, two panels were stolen, one of which – ‘The Just Judges’ – has never been recovered to this day, because the bishop refused to pay the ransom demanded….

programme.title: Celebrity Antiques Road Trip
programme.desc:
Strictly Come Dancing’s Zoe Ball and Ian Waite are quickstepping their way across the south West of England in a bid to turn a profit at auction in Hampshire. Experts Margie Cooper and Paul Laidlaw are on hand to guide. 

Paul shares a secret with Zoe about buying antique hair brushes. Ian, though, offers dancing lessons to dealers to secure a discount. Lordy! 

Zoe also hears how one village became world famous for lace production while Ian ends up meeting a giant horse with its own boat.

programme.title: Within the frame
programme.desc: Francisco de Goya (1746-1828) is a Spanish painter and engraver. He introduced several stylistic breaks that initiated Romanticism and announced the beginning of contemporary painting. His works include easel paintings, murals, engravings and drawings. We will discover works such as “Self-portrait with glasses”, “The sleep of reason produces monsters” or “The young ones”.

programme.title: Exhibition on Screen
programme.desc: Based on a major exhibition at the Ashmolean Museum in Oxford, Tokyo Stories spans 400 years of incredibly rich art, from Hokusai’s prints to Pop Art posters, via contemporary photography, manga, cinema and street art. The exhibition was a huge success and attracted a significantly younger and more diverse audience than usual. The film draws on the exhibition to take us to Tokyo and explore the city’s art and artistic figures in greater depth. A superbly illustrated and richly detailed documentary, which traces the journey of a metropolis marked by ceaseless cycles of destruction and rebirth throughout its 400-year history, to become one of the most dynamic and fascinating cities in the world today.

programme.title: Exhibition on Screen
programme.desc: Passionate about horticulture, Monet remains the undisputed master of garden painting in the history of art, but he was not alone. Artists such as Van Gogh, Bonnard, Picasso and Matisse used the garden as a strong theme in their work. These great artists, along with many other famous names, are brought together in an innovative exhibition from the Cleveland Museum of Art and the Royal Gallery of Arts in London. From the exhibition itself to the beauty of artists' gardens such as Monet's at Giverny, we take a journey to discover how the modern garden was used to explore radical and wondrous new ideas.

programme.title: Exhibition on Screen
programme.desc: Who was Frida Kahlo? Journey into the life of a true icon, discover her art and the truth behind her often turbulent life. The combination of interviews, commentary and a detailed exploration of Kahlo's art offers a treasure trove of color and a feast of vitality. This intimate, personal documentary provides privileged access to her works, and sheds light on her feverish creativity, resilience and unparalleled thirst for life.

programme.title: Exhibition on Screen
programme.desc: The National Gallery in London is one of the world’s greatest art galleries. It is brimming with masterpieces, an inexhaustible treasure trove of history and an endless source of stories. This film gives a voice to those whose lives have been touched by the Gallery, from the security guard to the director, including daily visitors, celebrities and members of the royal family. Claudia Winkleman, Michael Palin, Terry Gilliam, Jacqueline Wilson and Her Royal Highness Princess Eugenie reveal their deeply personal connection to the National Gallery.

programme.title: Exhibition on Screen
programme.desc: Pablo Picasso is one of the world's greatest artists, and until his death in 1973, he was its most prolific. How did it all begin? After being ignored for too long, it's time to focus on the artist's early years and the upbringing that enabled him to achieve the extraordinary. Three cities played a key role: Malaga, Barcelona and Paris. Young Picasso traverses them and explores their influence on the artist, analyzing specific works from his early years.

programme.title: Exhibition on Screen
programme.desc: The Impressionists are the most popular group in art history - millions flock every year to marvel at their masterpieces. But, to begin with, they were scorned, penniless outsiders. 1874 was the year that changed everything; the first Impressionists, “hungry for independence”, broke the mould by holding their own exhibition outside official channels. Impressionism was born and the art world was changed forever.\r\nWhat led to that first groundbreaking show 150 years ago? Who were the maverick personalities that wielded their brushes in such a radical and provocative way? The spectacular Musée d’Orsay exhibition brings fresh eyes to this extraordinary tale of passion and rebellion. The story is told not by historians and curators but in the words of those who witnessed the dawn of Impressionism: the artists, press and people of Paris, 1874. See the show that changed everything on the big screen.

programme.title: Celebrity Antiques Road Trip
programme.desc:
Actor and charmer Nigel Havers and his canny, deal-making chum (and ex-agent) Michael Whitehall explore the West Country. Travelling by Bentley and TVR, they’ll have £400 each and expert advice from Margie Cooper and James Braxton. 

But what will do best at the auction... Nigel’s old cockle bucket or Michael’s tambourine? 

Plus there’s a trip to see some Bristol Savages and bit of Georgian elegance with the story of ‘The King of Bath’.

programme.title: Celebrity Antiques Road Trip
programme.desc:
A celebrity couple Road Trip – award winning journalists John Stapleton and Lynn Faulds Wood.
 
Joining them on this jolly jaunt are Thomas Plant and Margie Cooper. With £400 in their pockets the teams kick off in Wrightington, Lancashire and head to Stockport for auction. 

Lynn and Thomas find themselves literally knee deep in antiques while hunting for old biscuit tins while Margie tries to convince John some rare lamps will make a profit. 

Also John learns how an American revolutionised British public transport and Lynn sees why snakes are milked in Liverpool.

programme.title: China-France: Glory of civilizations
programme.desc:
From the 17th century, Chinese objects dazzled the kings of France and found their way into the Versailles palace. Conversely, French tapestries and astronomical instruments enthralled Emperor Kangxi’s China. For centuries, this sumptuous furniture has been weaving a unique relationship between the two countries.

Engendering fascination, imitation and transformation, these masterpieces have fueled a sustained conversation between the two cultures, following the evolution of morals and fashions. An exchange nurtured by emblematic and visionary figures, from Louis XIV to Charles de Gaulle, from Arcade Huang (interpreter of the Sun King) to Shen Fuzong, from Marie Antoinette to Victor Hugo. 

To coincide with an exhibition at the Palace Museum (Beijing), this film draws four centuries of artistic dialogue between East and West. Propelled into the heart of grandiose settings – the Château de Versailles, the Forbidden City, Jingdezhen (the “Porcelain Capital”) – we become privileged spec.

programme.title: Exhibition on Screen
programme.desc: A remarkable event occurred at London’s National Gallery when the largest ever collection of Leonardo’s surviving paintings was assembled in a unique exhibition: Leonardo da Vinci: Painter at the Court of Milan. \r\nLeonardo is recognised as perhaps the greatest painter and sculptor of all time but there was no end to his talents. This film tells his life story and expands on Leonardo the visionary and inventor from the place where he lived out his final years at Château du Clos Lucé in France, concluding that Leonardo da Vinci was perhaps the very embodiment of the spirit of the Renaissance.

programme.title: Exhibition on Screen
programme.desc: Hopper’s work is the most recognisable art in America – popular, praised, and mysterious. Countless painters, photographers, filmmakers and musicians have been influenced by his art – but who was he, and how did a struggling illustrator create such a bounty of notable work?\r\nThis new film takes a deep look into Hopper’s art, his life, and his relationships. From his early career as an illustrator; his wife giving up her own promising art career to be his manager; his critical and commercial acclaim; and in his own words – this film explores the enigmatic personality behind the brush….

programme.title: Exhibition on Screen
programme.desc: With loans from across the world, this major retrospective brings together Vermeer’s most famous masterpieces including Girl with a Pearl Earring, The Geographer, The Milkmaid, The Little Street, Lady Writing a Letter with her Maid, and Woman Holding a Balance. In all, 28 of his surviving 37 works. This film invites audiences to a privileged view of the exhibition, accompanied by the director of the Rijksmuseum and the curators of the show. A truly once-in-a-lifetime opportunity to discover the genius of Vermeer and his fascinating and mysterious life.

programme.title: Architectures
programme.desc: In China's Zhejiang province, a strange animal crawls out of adobe. Wa Shan, literally "tile mountain", is a rather unusual guesthouse, built between 2011 and 2013 by Chinese architect Wang Shu. Winding along a river and disappearing in places behind wild vegetation, the guesthouse is set in a landscape of mountains and water. Wang Shu is a great scenographer and is renowned for his commitment to sustainable architecture. The guesthouse was built using recycled materials and rammed earth, a provocation in a country that concretes at every turn.

programme.title: Artist's Workshop
programme.desc: Kimiko Yoshida has settled in a working-class neighborhood in the northeast of Paris. Her house is at the same time an exhibition gallery, a reception room and a studio. Initially a photographer, she has become a visual artist. The self-portrait is a motif that punctuates the artist's work. But paradoxically, she flees vanity to aim at disappearance.

programme.title: Celebrity Antiques Road Trip
programme.desc:
Comic and entertainer Jim Moir and his wife Nancy Sorrell are Road Tripping in Kent today. 

Better known as Vic Reeves, Jim brings his unique brand of humour to the business of buying antiques. While model and TV presenter Nancy also knows a thing or two about bargaining and she’s very competitive! The couple are ably assisted by experts Charlie Ross and Thomas Plant. 

Look out for Jim’s uncanny gift of guessing the age of just about anything, Dixon crossing the Niagara Falls and how to navigate by Longitude. 

Plus will the mysterious Mrs Parker turn up to the auction?

programme.title: Photo Contest
programme.desc: Today, we invite you to Lyon. The two candidates of the day, Christophe Boulair and Julien Arnaud, will have one hour to compete on the theme of Old Lyon. They will have to walk around the old town in search of the best spot to take the most beautiful picture as possible.

programme.title: Artist's Workshop
programme.desc: In this episode, we will meet the artist Richard Texier. He is now considered one of the best living artists of his generation. His work is based on the Pantheo Vortex, an artistic exploration of the mystery and beauty of the world. His works can be found in numerous public and private collections, both in France and abroad.

programme.title: An hour with...
programme.desc: Take an hour break to discover the work of a Flemish painter, Pierre Paul Rubens. You will discover his labour with Samson and Dalilah, The four philosophers or The education of Marie de’Medici.

programme.title: An hour with...
programme.desc: Take an hour break to discover the work of a French painter, Édouard Vuillard. You will discover his labour with Sleep, The Piano or Portrait de madame Henri Vaquez.

programme.title: Exhibition on Screen
programme.desc: A remarkable event occurred at London’s National Gallery when the largest ever collection of Leonardo’s surviving paintings was assembled in a unique exhibition: Leonardo da Vinci: Painter at the Court of Milan. \r\nLeonardo is recognised as perhaps the greatest painter and sculptor of all time but there was no end to his talents. This film tells his life story and expands on Leonardo the visionary and inventor from the place where he lived out his final years at Château du Clos Lucé in France, concluding that Leonardo da Vinci was perhaps the very embodiment of the spirit of the Renaissance.

programme.title: Within the frame
programme.desc: Between 1883 and 1926 Claude Monet lived in a house at Giverny where he created a flower garden and a water garden, which provided the inspiration for his series of paintings known as the “Water Lilies”. The “Water-Lily Pond” portrays this garden, with its water lilies and the Japanese bridge in the background. In the series of eight large canvases on the theme, housed in the Musée de l’Orangerie in Paris, Monet introduces variations in light according to the hour of the day.\r\nEnjoy your visit!

programme.title: Art Quiz
programme.desc: Test and develop your artistic culture with Art Quiz, the game that will allow you to become unaware of art. Whether it's artists, works of art, artistic trends, the price of works... nothing will be a secret for you anymore. Now it's your turn to play!

programme.title: Architectures
programme.desc: A tall tower in the heart of Copenhagen, the RADISSON SAS ROYAL HOTEL is both a grand modern hotel and an airline terminal, marking Denmark's entry into post-war modernity. It was a major work of the 1950s, under the banner of functionalism, simplicity and elegance. This total work of art, where everything from the ashtray to the volume of the building was conceived and designed by the same man, Arne Jacobsen, the great Scandinavian architect and designer.

programme.title: Architectures
programme.desc: In 1995, the City of Luxembourg decided to build a large concert hall on the Kirchberg plateau, the new district of banks and major European institutions.\r\nThe aim of the commission was to bring together three major public performance spaces in a single complex: a large philharmonic hall, a small chamber music hall and a discovery space. \r\nArchitect Christian de Portzamparc, admirably assisted by the experience of acoustician Xu Yaying, made this hall his great musical instrument. The elliptical shape, with its filter of white columns and coloured cliffs, reveals the auditorium as a real jewel in its setting, one of the architect's most beautiful buildings.

programme.title: China-France: Glory of civilizations
programme.desc:
From the 17th century, Chinese objects dazzled the kings of France and found their way into the Versailles palace. Conversely, French tapestries and astronomical instruments enthralled Emperor Kangxi’s China.
